message.content: {"label":"sufficient","reason":"The passages collectively provide explicit statements on how Uber plans to use IPO proceeds, including general corporate purposes, potential acquisitions/investments, RSU tax withholding obligations, and capital-preservation investments pending use, with management discretion.","supported_requirements":[{"requirement":"General corporate purposes including working capital, operating expenses, and capital expenditures","passage_rank":1,"quote":"We intend to use the net proceeds we receive from this offering for general corporate purposes, including working capital, operating expenses, and capital expenditures."},{"requirement":"May use proceeds to acquire or invest in businesses, products, offerings, and technologies","passage_rank":1,"quote":"We may also use a portion of the net proceeds to acquire or make investments in businesses, products, offerings, and technologies, although we do not have agreements or commitments for any material acquisitions or investments at this time."},{"requirement":"RSU tax withholding and remittance obligations approximately $1.3 billion in aggregate","passage_rank":1,"quote":"we expect to use some of the net proceeds from this offering to satisfy a portion of the anticipated tax withholding and remittance obligations related to the settlement of our outstanding RSUs that will vest in connection with this offering... approximately $1.3 billion in the aggregate."},{"requirement":"Proceeds to be invested in capital-preservation investments pending use","passage_rank":1,"quote":"Pending their use, we intend to invest the net proceeds of this offering in a variety of capital-preservation investments, including short- and intermediate-term investments, interest-bearing investments, investment-grade securities, government securities, and money market funds."},{"requirement":"Management will have broad discretion in applying the net proceeds","passage_rank":1,"quote":"our management will have broad discretion in applying the net proceeds of this offering."},{"requirement":"Total net proceeds estimate and from PayPal private placement","passage_rank":1,"quote":"We estimate that net proceeds to us from the sale of our common stock in this offering will be approximately $8.0 billion after deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. Additionally, our proceeds from the private placement to PayPal will be $500 million."}],"missing_requirements":[],"concerns":[]}
